scripts.prebuild:netlify: echo '🔧 Préparation du build Netlify...' && mkdir -p temp-sw && find public -name 'sw*.js' -exec mv {} temp-sw/ \; 2>/dev/null || true && find public -name 'workbox*.js' -exec mv {} temp-sw/ \; 2>/dev/null || true && find public -name '*sw*.js' -exec mv {} temp-sw/ \; 2>/dev/null || true && find public -name '*workbox*' -exec mv {} temp-sw/ \; 2>/dev/null || true && echo '🔍 Vérification des fichiers restants...' && if find public -name '*workbox*' -o -name '*sw*.js' | grep -q .; then echo '⚠️ Des fichiers service worker sont encore présents:' && find public -name '*workbox*' -o -name '*sw*.js' && echo '🗑️ Suppression forcée...' && find public -name '*workbox*' -o -name '*sw*.js' -delete; else echo '✅ Tous les fichiers service worker ont été déplacés'; fi
scripts.postbuild:netlify: echo '🔄 Restauration des service workers...' && mv temp-sw/* public/ 2>/dev/null || true && rmdir temp-sw 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build:netlify:ultra-secure: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_ENV=production NETLIFY=true DEBUG_SELF_REFERENCE_FIXER=true next build --no-lint
scripts.build:netlify:enhanced: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_ENV=production NETLIFY=true WEBPACK_SELF_FIXER=true next build --no-lint --no-mangling
scripts.build:netlify:with-cleanup: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_ENV=production NETLIFY=true WEBPACK_SELF_FIXER=true next build --no-lint --no-mangling && node scripts/post-build-cleanup.js
scripts.build:netlify:minimal: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NODE_ENV=production NETLIFY=true USE_ALTERNATIVE_WEBPACK=true next build --no-lint --no-mangling
scripts.test:secure-build: echo '🧪 Test local du build sécurisé...' && ./scripts/netlify-build-secure.sh
scripts.test:secure-build:local: echo '🧪 Test local du build sécurisé (mode local)...' && NODE_ENV=development ./scripts/netlify-build-secure.sh
scripts.build:frontend-only: mv app/api app/api.disabled && next build --no-lint --no-mangling && mv app/api.disabled app/api
scripts.build:core-only: mv app/admin app/admin.disabled && next build --no-lint --no-mangling && mv app/admin.disabled app/api
scripts.deploy:hybrid: echo '🚀 Déploiement hybride: Frontend sur Netlify, APIs sur Vercel' && echo '1. Déployer les APIs sur Vercel avec: vercel --prod' && echo '2. Mettre à jour netlify.toml avec l'URL Vercel' && echo '3. Déployer le frontend sur Netlify'
scripts.deploy:vercel: echo '🔧 Déploiement des APIs sur Vercel...' && vercel --prod
scripts.deploy:netlify: echo '🌐 Déploiement du frontend sur Netlify...' && echo 'Utilisez: git push origin main'
